title: Traces and logs
description: One update, followed all the way through. Paste a trace id into the variable at the top and the trace, its spans and its log lines all appear together — that join is the thing this stack exists to provide, and it only works because every log line carries the trace it belongs to.

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Trace ID
list.description: Paste one from the search panel below, from an exemplar on the metrics dashboard, or from a log line.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: service.name as the app reports it — cb-gateway, cb-api, cb-worker.

options.content:
**Start at the bottom.** The search panel lists recent traces; click one to fill in `trace_id` above, and the two panels in the middle fill with that trace's spans and that trace's log lines side by side.

Coming the other way works too: a spike on **Bot metrics** carries exemplars — click one and Grafana brings you here with the id already set.

If the log panel is empty for a trace that clearly has spans, the log line was written without trace context (a module logging outside a request, or before instrumentation runs). That is a finding, not a glitch.

panels.title: Trace: $trace_id
panels.description: The whole update, span by span. A gap between spans is real work nobody instrumented — usually where the time actually went.

panels.title: Logs for this trace
panels.description: Every line any service wrote while handling this update, in order, across process boundaries — the gateway and the worker that picked up its job share a trace id.

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: A warning rate that climbs while the error rate stays flat is the shape of a degraded dependency being handled correctly — worth seeing, not worth paging on.

panels.title: Recent warnings and errors ($service)
panels.description: The unfiltered feed, for when you do not yet have a trace id — find the line that looks wrong, click its trace_id, and the panels above fill in.

panels.title: Recent traces — click one to fill in the id above
panels.description: TraceQL over the last window. Sorted by duration rather than by time, because the trace worth opening is almost never the most recent one.
